status: In text.json as Fable's hand edits: each row carries `hand`, so no run of the style loop replaces it (guide /17). Scored once by Motive on Claude Opus 5.5 with Sky's approval (bun tools/style-agent/cli.ts judge FAMILY --hand briefs/102/fable/hand-barks.json; runs/style-agent/short/2026-11-08T15-58-54.321Z-bark-witnesses-crowd and 2026-11-08T15-58-56.270Z-bark-summons). 8 of the 13 drew no finding and stand as judged; the 5 with a finding were rewritten from it (`judged` keeps the line Opus read and what it said) and have not been scored again.
why: Brief 102's sweep (Sky 2026-11-08: "yes - rewrites are much better"): six passes each, gpt-6.1-sol writing and Opus judging, brought neither family to 10, so the 13 lines still failing the bar are written by hand to the same bar: nobody explains the game, a person talking for their own reasons, no AI-sounding words, and true every time the row plays. The other lines of these rows stay as they are.

edits.before: I'm going to tell the police.
edits.after: That poor soul. I'll fetch someone.
edits.why: It announced the report the HUD already shows. Now pity, and the passer-by sets off. True whether they saw it done, saw a body carried or found one, and whether they run or walk.
Now the passer-by's hurry as they set off, short and human, with no word about where they're going or what follows.

judged.line: Here? In this city? I won't have it.
judged.finding: A little stagey and civic-minded for a startled passer-by: close, but not short and human enough.

edits.why: A terrified person doesn't announce that they won't report it. Fear, true of a takedown, a carried body and a body found alike.
The same non-report, read out a second time. Now what a frightened person says as they go.

edits.after: I've a family to think of.
edits.why: It narrated the quiet as a plan. Now the reason this passer-by keeps out of it, beside the row's decision and shrug.

edits.after: Good grief. What's gone on here?
edits.why: Now his first words as he takes it in: a door guard's question, clipped, with nothing about him the game doesn't know. True of a body found, a takedown and a carry alike.

judged.line: Never, in all my years on the door.
judged.finding: It makes up a service history the item doesn't give, and it's sentimental rather than clipped.

edits.after: That's a coward's work, that is.
edits.why: Now a rules man's judgement of whoever did it, in his own blunt words, with no order to bystanders who may not be there.

judged.line: Easy, now. Do it properly, by the book.
judged.finding: He coaches himself out loud, and nobody says that while reaching for a radio; "by the book" is a cliché.

edits.before: I came once. The door can't spare me twice.
edits.after: I've been off this door enough today, Inez.
edits.why: "Can't spare me twice" recites the one-visit rule. Now his own reason. He is back on his door, so "this door".

edits.before: He's too far from his post, I'm afraid. No quick visit.
edits.after: Bless him, he'd be ages getting here.
edits.why: "No quick visit" names the summons' limit, and he isn't far from his post: he is on it, a long walk from her. Now Inez on the telephone, fond and practical.

edits.before: I'm too far from the door for a quick visit, Inez.
edits.after: Not from where I'm standing, Inez.
edits.why: The same rule, and the wrong fact: he is at the door and the café is far. Now a clipped refusal from his post.

edits.before: Nobody available to call over, Inez.
edits.after: Fetch Inez? What good would that do you?
edits.why: Said to the Fixer: he doesn't see what Inez coming over would do for anyone, which is the call's true reason, in his words.

judged.line: Leave Inez out of this. That's final.
judged.finding: It invents a motive: the fact is that his tie, Inez, has no post to leave, so the call moves nobody; he isn't refusing to involve her.

edits.before: No one available, Inez. Nobody you can send for.
edits.after: Inez has her tables, and I have my door.
edits.why: Said to the Fixer: each of them has their own place, so there's nothing a call would change. Plain facts, no invented refusal.

judged.line: I said I'd help you. I never said Inez would.
judged.finding: Like the line before it, it makes up a refusal: he isn't refusing anything, there's simply nobody this call would move.

edits.before: I remember them, officer. Here, let me tell you what happened.
edits.after: That's the one, officer. I'm not taking the blame for anybody.
edits.why: Sky turned it down: it says the game's word, remember. Now a pressured Inez giving the Fixer up for her own reason. Not played yet (investigators come later).
